    How to check if ChatGPT mentions your brand

    An AI visibility checker answers one question: when a buyer asks an AI assistant for a recommendation, is your brand in the answer? Rank trackers can't tell you this, because there's no page of results, just one written reply.

    The most reliable way is also the simplest: ask the assistants yourself, the way a buyer would. That's what the checker above sets up for you.

    1. Ask buyer questions, not your brand name. "Best invoicing app for freelancers" shows whether you're recommended. "What is Tallybook?" only shows whether the AI has heard of you.
    2. Check more than one assistant. ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Mode read different sources and often name different brands.
    3. Note who is named instead. The competitors in the answer tell you which pages and reviews the AI is reading.
    4. Repeat it. Answers drift week to week, so one check is a snapshot.

    How to get your brand mentioned by ChatGPT

    AI assistants recommend what the web already says about you. To show up in ChatGPT and rank in AI search, make it easy for that web to describe you correctly.

    • Say what you are, in one sentence

      Put "an invoicing app for freelancers" in plain words on your homepage title and first paragraph. AI can't recommend you for a category it can't match you to.

    • Get onto the pages AI reads

      "Best X for Y" lists, comparison articles and directories are where assistants find names. Ask to be included, and publish your own honest comparison pages.

    • Be talked about on third-party sites

      Reviews, Reddit threads, podcasts and customer case studies count more than your own claims. Answer questions in communities where your buyers ask.

    • Let AI crawlers in

      Check that your robots.txt doesn't block GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended. An llms.txt file can summarise your site for AI, though not every assistant uses it yet.

    • Answer one question per page

      Pages that answer a single buyer question near the top are the ones that show up in Google AI Overviews and get quoted by Perplexity.

      Questions about AI visibility

      Is there a free AI visibility checker?

      Yes, this one. It's free and needs no account. Instead of guessing with a model of its own, it opens the real ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Mode with your questions, so what you see is what your buyers see.

      Does ChatGPT know my business?

      The checker includes one question that asks the assistant about your brand by name. If the answer is wrong or empty, the AI hasn't found enough about you yet. That's a different problem from not being recommended, and both are worth fixing.

      How do I show up in ChatGPT?

      Describe your product clearly on your own site, get included on comparison and "best of" pages, collect third-party reviews and mentions, and allow AI crawlers. See how to get mentioned above.

      How do I appear in Google AI Overviews?

      AI Overviews and AI Mode lean on pages that already rank and answer the question directly. One clear page per buyer question, indexed in Google Search Console, is the place to start.

      How is the AI visibility score worked out?

      Each recommendation question scores 100 if you're named first, 60 if you're named, and 0 if you're not. The score is the average across the answers you've marked.

      Why does ChatGPT give a different answer each time?

      Answers change with the model, wording, date, location and whether web search is on. Run the same check again in a few weeks to see the trend.

      Do you save what I type?

      Your brand, questions and marks stay in this browser. We use Google Analytics to count visits and which buttons are used, without your brand or questions. Your email is only sent if you leave it for the weekly check.
